recognize_zh: 視野中血小板稀少，唯一的一顆血小板體積大（約紅血球直徑的一半以上）、顆粒明顯，紅血球形態正常；血小板低下合併巨大血小板，放在 Bernard-Soulier 症候群脈絡下即為其特徵性的巨血小板。
features: Single large granular platelet at upper left, roughly half to two-thirds the diameter of adjacent RBCs
Platelet shows central purple granulomere with paler hyalomere
Marked scarcity of platelets elsewhere in the field
Red cells normocytic and normochromic without poikilocytosis or schistocytes
No leukocytes in view to assess for Dohle-like inclusions
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows decreased platelets, with a single enlarged platelet measuring roughly half to two-thirds the diameter of a red cell and containing a distinct central granulomere. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic without fragmentation. No leukocytes are present in this field to evaluate for neutrophil inclusions. Findings are consistent with macrothrombocytopenia, compatible with Bernard-Soulier syndrome in the appropriate clinical context; confirmation requires absent ristocetin-induced aggregation not corrected by normal plasma and reduced GPIb-IX-V by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: ITP platelets are variably large but not uniformly giant, the disorder is acquired, and ristocetin aggregation and GPIb expression are normal.
MYH9 disorders show giant platelets with blue Dohle-like inclusions in neutrophils and normal ristocetin aggregation.
Gray platelets are large but pale grey and agranular due to absent alpha granules, unlike the granular platelet here.
Glanzmann thrombasthenia has normal platelet count and size, with absent aggregation to all agonists except ristocetin.
